prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation sprite sheet, replacing faulty cavalry hoof anatomy and sideways sliding. Input reference is ONLY for character appearance, materials, colors, and painterly game art. Make the SAME Chinese mounted commander: adult male, dark steel lamellar armor, red cape and helmet plume, upright long spear, chestnut brown horse, restrained red/gold tack. No change of equipment, breed, scale or identity.
Create EXACTLY TWELVE distinct sequential full-body frames of one smooth natural brisk TROT cycle. EXACT grid SIX equal columns by TWO equal rows, row-major, ONE figure per cell. 1536x512 transparent canvas, twelve 256-square cells, all weapons, mane, hooves and tails safely inside each cell. No text, gridlines, floor or cast shadows. Actual alpha transparency, not a checkerboard.
FIXED slightly elevated isometric camera, uniform light/exposure and stable rider/horse torso position across frames. Do not turn between frames. Frame 0/6 are opposite diagonal support phases: near foreleg plus far hindleg, then far foreleg plus near hindleg; intermediate frames show load, push-off, flexion, passing, extension, and touchdown. Keep proportions consistent and transition last frame into first.
ANATOMY IS CRITICAL: exactly four horse legs attached at shoulder/hip with correct fore-knee/fetlock and hind stifle/hock joints. Four SOLID SINGLE hooves, flat dark keratin cups continuous with each pastern, never toes/claws/cloven hooves, blobs, floating foot bits, extra legs or detached limbs. Hooves land flat with weight, then lift naturally. Distinct far/near legs, leg-length constant. No permanently curled leg, no back-bending foreleg, no stretching/morphing body. Clean sharp silhouettes, painted realistic miniature matching the reference. Consistent contact ground plane near y=238 of each cell, horse pelvis stable; modest bob of torso only, no sprite drift.
VIEW TO USE IN EVERY ONE OF THE 12 CELLS: RIGHT SIDE VIEW. Horse points exactly to screen right, its ground travel vector horizontal (1,0).
